_how_to: Scottie and Eddie: this file decides which video each member sees on their Wall.
promo = the 5th box on the member's Wall. It always pitches what comes next.
tour = the 'Your ... Level tools' link next to the level name. It reminds members what they already have.
Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link into url when a video is ready. While url is empty, the box opens the Membership levels page.
title and line are what the box says. Keep title under 45 characters. No em dashes.
covers is a checklist for the script writer: what the video must walk through.
